sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Ankur Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Naval Kishor Gupta - Public Prosecutor for the   ORDER
This application under section 438 of Cr.P.C/482 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail.
The applicant is apprehending his arrest in Crime No.433/2024, registered at Police Station Bahodapur, District Gwalior for offence under Sections 419 and 420 of IPC.

It is submitted by counsel for applicant that he would like to rely on certain more documents,
therefore, he may be permitted to withdraw this application with liberty to file a properly constituted fresh application with all relevant documents.
With aforesaid liberty, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE PjS/-
